items.title: A limit of topological groups with the descending chain condition is closed in the product
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the limit of an inverse system of topological groups satisfying the descending chain condition is closed in the product (author lemma at source lines 5974-5979, label lemma-topological-group-limits). The proof (source lines 5981-5995) writes the limit as the intersection of the compatibility conditions inside the product and observes that each of them is closed by continuity of the transition maps (proof lines 5981-5994). The description of the limit as an intersection of closed conditions is the content. H3.
